pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: proportional representation / electoral systems

patterns: Very few PYQs: APPSC asks this topic as direct definitional items, e.g. 'which is NOT a basis of stratification' (language) and an AP-history angle (Saivism aided upward mobility in medieval Andhra).

Likely shapes: theorist -> concept (Sanskritisation-Srinivas, Davis-Moore functionalism, Weber class/status/party), types of mobility (vertical/horizontal, inter/intra-generational), ascribed vs achieved status.
AP tilt: medieval Andhra religion and caste mobility (Saivism, Kakatiya martial castes) is the APPSC-specific angle.

App MCQs lean heavily on sociology-textbook theory and 2025-26 data (Economic Survey, Telangana survey, middle-class definitions) - far more volume and depth than the PYQs show; several generated match items are tautological.
